name: Anthropic MCP
tagline: Use Claude models and Anthropic APIs from your AI agent.
shortDescription: The Anthropic MCP server. Call any Claude model (Sonnet, Opus, Haiku), use prompt caching, generate batch completions, and inspect usage. The canonical way to use Anthropic from your agent.
longDescription:
## What it is

The official Anthropic MCP server. Exposes the Anthropic API as MCP tools: chat completions with any Claude model, prompt caching, batch completions (50% cheaper), tool use, and vision.

## Why we recommend it

If your agent uses Claude, this is the cleanest way. The agent can pick the right model per task, cache large prompts (90% cost reduction), and use the batch API for asynchronous workloads.

## When to use it

- Model selection: agent picks Sonnet/Opus/Haiku based on complexity
- Cost optimization: agent uses prompt caching for repeated context
- Batch: agent submits large evaluation batches at half the cost
- Vision: agent analyzes images with Claude's vision capabilities
installInstructions:
1. Get an API key at https://console.anthropic.com
2. Set `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...`
3. `npx -y @anthropic/mcp`
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. Anthropic API: pay per token. Free credits for new accounts.
